title: BHB Business OS: Smart Structure Engineering Business Operating System
description: A Persian-first, offline-capable business operating system for structural engineers. The software combines client relationship management, financial tracking, AI-assisted content planning, five engineering revenue pathways, and an actionable 30-day growth roadmap in an installable progressive web application.

creators.name: Bahram Beigi, Yousef
creators.affiliation: PhD Student in Civil Engineering (Structures), Islamic Azad University
